title: feat(app-shell, auth, plugin-grid, plugin-list): Setup → Users and the console on a cloud-managed environment (objectui#13330)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMRtFBARXxNvcE3v2DW5kAK)_

Fixes #13330
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

The console half of the objectstack-ai/objectstack#25083 ruling (comment 6341690661, Q1 B / Q3 A / Q4 A). When `/auth/config` serves `features.cloudManaged: true`, the console says what the server already enforces. People are invited to the hosting organization in the cloud, and the environment keeps authorization and view. When the flag is absent or `false`, every surface below is unchanged, and each one has a pinned control for that.

## What changes on a managed environment

| Surface | Flag `true` | Flag absent / `false` |
|---|---|---|
| Setup → Users list | One line above the list says where to invite people. A user who holds no permission set beyond the baseline shows a 「未授权」 / "Not authorized" marker beside their name. | No line, no marker, no grant reads. |
| Setup → Users identity import (`identityImportEnabled`) | Not offered. The server answers `admin/import-users` with 409. | Offered to an admin, as before. |
| Organization → Members | A note ("People join through your organization in the cloud. Invite them there.") instead of Invite member. The invite dialog is not mounted. | Invite member, as before. This also holds while `/auth/config` has not answered, or cannot. |
| Recovery-password reminder | Not shown. | Unchanged. |

The `invite_user`, `create_user` and `set_user_password` actions are hidden by their own served `visible` predicates (the engine lane's item on objectstack-ai/objectstack#25083), not by console code.

The console reads the flag directly from `/auth/config` into its own `AuthPublicConfig` type. So this PR does not wait for the `.objectstack-sha` pin (`06cab48`, 18.0.0) to cover objectstack-ai/objectstack#25309, which serves the flag.

## The marker: what "beyond the baseline" reads

Every signed-in user holds the baseline: the sets that the `everyone` anchor position lists (the platform's `member_default` and the defaults the environment accepted). A user holds something beyond the baseline when a grant that is active now (`valid_from` / `valid_until`, half-open, the window the server enforces) does either of these:
- a `sys_user_permission_set` row names a set that the anchor does not list;
- a `sys_user_position` row names a position other than an anchor (`everyone`, `guest`) whose registry definition lists such a set.

These are the same reads that the permission set's Assigned Users section makes, asked by user instead of by set. One loader per list batches every marker the page draws, so a page costs one read per object: `$filter: { user_id: { $in: [...] } }`, 50 users per read, `$top: 1000`. The loader is rebuilt when the list refreshes. Unknown never counts as "not authorized": a refused read, an answer the server reports as cut short (`hasMore`, or a `total` longer than the page), or a position the registry does not define all leave the user unmarked.

## The new host prop: `rowAdornment`

`ListView` → `ObjectGrid` had no per-row slot a host could draw into. Both packages already take host-only React props for this kind of need, never schema keys: `rowOperations`, `objectFields` and `showRowNumbers` on the grid, and `toolbarLeading` on the list. So the marker rides one generic prop, named for what it draws (ADR-0060 rule 2):
- `ObjectGrid.rowAdornment?: (record) => ReactNode` is drawn after the title cell's own content. That is the declared `nameField` column when a column shows it, else the first shown column, never the row actions. In the card view it sits beside the card title. The cell's value, link and mask stay as drawn. A `null` return draws nothing, and an absent prop renders exactly as before.
- `ListView.rowAdornment` is destructured by name and handed only to the grid, in the same way as `showRowNumbers`. The board and the other visualizations, and the compact posture, are not handed it.

The card's claim first planned the marker as a second PR behind a ruling. Correction 6365253236 on the card records why it is in this PR instead, and the revised file surface. If contract review would rather take it separately, it comes out cleanly: the two props, their wiring in `ObjectView.tsx`, the marker and their tests. Nothing else in this PR depends on it.

## What changed

- `packages/auth/src/types.ts`: `AuthPublicConfig['features'].cloudManaged`, documented beside `ssoEnforced`. The auth README has a new `features.cloudManaged` section.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/managedEnvironmentUsers.tsx` (new): `isManagedEnvironment`, `ManagedUsersInviteLine`, the grant read (`readUserGrantStates`, `isGrantActive`), the batching `UserGrantLoader`, and `UnauthorizedUserMarker`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`: the identity import gate, the invite line on the `sys_user` list, and `rowAdornment` passed to `ListView`. The metadata store is read through a ref, and the loader lives in a ref keyed on the refresh key and the data source, so no correctness rests on a memoised identity (AGENTS.md #10).
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/MembersPage.tsx`: reads `/auth/config` itself, and the note takes the button's place (the objectui#4475 convention). This is an edit to an existing file under the frozen directory. No file is added there, apart from a test.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/RecoveryPasswordReminder.tsx`: skips the reminder when the flag is `true`.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` and `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`: `rowAdornment`, with docblocks, README sections, and the mirrored `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx` section.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (all ten): `console.objectView.managedUsers.{inviteLine,unauthorized,unauthorizedHint}` and `organization.members.inviteManagedNote`. No key name leads with a product word, and no frozen namespace grows.
- `.changeset/13330-managed-environment-users.md`: `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-list` minor (a new public member or prop each); `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Tests

New pins. Each case is paired with a control in which the flag is absent or `false`, or the prop is absent:
- `ObjectView.managedEnvironmentUsers-13330.test.tsx` runs the real `ObjectView` → `ListView` → `ObjectGrid` chain with the en bundle. It checks that the invite line shows, and that the marker appears on a baseline-only user and on a user whose only grant has expired, but not on a user with a direct grant or a granting position. It checks that one read per object is asked by user, and that identity import is not offered. In the control, the line, the marker and the grant reads are all absent, and identity import is offered.
- `__tests__/managedEnvironmentUsers-13330.test.tsx`: the flag reader, the grant window bounds, a baseline set held explicitly, positions and anchors, an undefined position, both shapes of a truncated answer, a refused read, and the marker drawing nothing on a refused read.
- `RecoveryPasswordReminder.cloudManaged-13330.test.tsx`, `members-invite-managed-13330.test.tsx`, `rowAdornment-13330.test.tsx` (grid: name-field cell, first column, card title, control) and `ListView.rowAdornment-13330.test.tsx` (grid handed it, board not, control).

Ablation, run on the committed tree and then restored: each of these reverts turns its pin red while the controls stay green. Dropping the import gate, the members note, the reminder skip, the invite line, the grid placement (table and card), the list forwarding, the name-field preference, and the `valid_until` bound.

Run locally, on a box shared with other agents:
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid packages/plugin-list packages/auth packages/i18n packages/app-shell/src/views packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations packages/app-shell/src/console/home` plus the product-neutral ratchet: 1689 files and 16573 tests. The first run had 3 failures, in two i18n pins that count live keys: `de-quote-pairing-3876` (paired „…“ spans, 91 → 92) and `objectView-config-keys-retired-4730` (surviving `console.objectView` keys, 104 → 105, total 228 → 229). Both are advanced in the second commit with the same narration their histories use, and both pass after merging `main`, along with `all-locales-key-parity`, the ratchet and the end-to-end pin.
- `turbo run type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `auth` and `i18n`: all tasks successful. One error, in this PR's own test double (an untyped `params` argument), was fixed in the second commit.
- `pnpm check:doc-snippets` after its scoped build: 811 of 811 blocks compile, including the new README and mdx snippets.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (4 keys added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (the new keys are not listed), `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-fences` and `check-changeset-presence`: all pass.
- NOT MEASURED live: a browser pass against a cloud-managed objectstack. The pins above use the real component chain with served-shape fixtures.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer). The surfaces read a platform flag that `@objectstack/spec` declares (`AuthFeaturesConfigSchema.cloudManaged`). The new prop is generic and named for what it draws. No file, registry key or locale key name leads with a product word.
